newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian motor-cyclists protest against paedophiles.
newsitem.headline: Belgian motor-cyclists protest against paedophiles.

text.p: Several thousand Belgian motor-cyclists brought traffic to a halt as they roared down the main street of the capital to protest against judicial bungling and corruption in the country's child sex and murder scandal.

"Paedophiles must quickly be brought to justice. They should not be given any remission," said Guy Dubart, leather-clad leader of the Dalton motor-cycle club from the French speaking, southern Belgian city of Tournai.
After a few minutes silence at a police barrier, the 3,000 motor-cyclists revved up their machines in an ear-splitting expression of anger.
Then they waited calmly while a delegation was allowed through to give a letter to King Albert, himself a motor-cycle enthusiast, before ending their protest at the Justice Palace.

Belgium has been in turmoil since mid-August when two young sexually abused girls were rescued from a secret dungeon in a house owned by rapist Marc Dutroux. The bodies of four other children missing for over a year were later dug up.
On Sunday, more than 100,000 people are expected to march through the centres of Brussels in a rally organised by the parents of some of the missing children.
